description: This file defines functions for decision logic related to failover behavior based on different failover reasons, such as whether to allow cooldown probes, use transient cooldown slots, or preserve transient cooldown slots.

methods.name: export function shouldAllowCooldownProbeForReason( shouldAllowCooldownProbeForReason
methods.description: Determines if a cooldown probe is allowed based on the FailoverReason.

methods.name: export function shouldUseTransientCooldownProbeSlot( shouldUseTransientCooldownProbeSlot
methods.description: Determines if a transient cooldown probe slot should be used based on the FailoverReason.

methods.name: export function shouldPreserveTransientCooldownProbeSlot( shouldPreserveTransientCooldownProbeSlot
methods.description: Determines if a transient cooldown probe slot should be preserved based on the FailoverReason.
